channel.title: Open Calls for Artists — Monographica
channel.description: Curated list of open calls for photographers and visual artists. Exhibitions, grants, residencies, and publications worldwide.

item.title: Landskrona Foto & Casa Planas Spring Residency 2027
item.description: A six-week residency in Landskrona, Sweden for a photographer, researcher, curator or cultural producer born or living in Catalonia or the Balearic Islands, developing a project on image, archives, tourism and territory. The €2,000 grant comes with travel, accommodation and curatorial support from Landskrona Foto's curators. Production costs fall to the selected applicant. — Deadline: January 11, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Prize: €2,000 grant + Residency.

item.title: ND Awards 2027
item.description: ND Awards is an annual international competition across architecture, editorial, fine art, nature, people and a special section, split into professional and non-professional levels with forty sub-categories. Photographer of the Year takes $3,500 and Discovery of the Year $2,400, with $400–$500 for each category winner. Fees rise after the April early deadline. — Deadline: September 19, 2027. Entry fee: $19–$34. Prize: $3,500 + $2,400.

item.title: A World in Stories — Artdoc Magazine Open Call · Artdoc Photography Magazine
item.description: Artdoc Magazine invites documentary and art photography that tells stories of the people, places and cultures shaping our world, from long-term projects to personal narratives. Selected work goes into a curated online exhibition or an issue of the magazine, with a possible portfolio interview. Entry is free but you must hold the €35-a-year membership, which renews automatically until you cancel. — Deadline: January 18, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Additional fees: €35/year Artdoc membership. Prize: Publication + Online exhibition.

item.title: Our Hidden Community: Artists with Chronic Pain · Chronic Pain Project
item.description: The Chronic Pain Project brings together artists living with chronic pain and their caregivers for a show at Second Story Gallery in the Camas Public Library. No art background is needed and all art modalities are accepted, with 3-D work especially encouraged, though the content screen is PG-13: no drugs, sex or alcohol. Artists are expected to live in the Portland, Oregon or Vancouver, Washington metro area; from further afield you pay two-way shipping. — Deadline: January 8, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Hampden Library — Call for Existing Two-Dimensional Artwork · Denver Arts & Venues
item.description: Denver's public art programme is buying finished, ready-to-hang two-dimensional work — photography is a named medium — for permanent display behind the main desk of the renovated Hampden Library. Up to $5,000 per artwork from a $25,000 budget, free to apply, open to artists anywhere in the United States. Works must be at least 24 by 24 inches and ready to hang. — Deadline: January 1, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Prize: $5,000 max + Permanent collection.

item.title: CWA Photo Competition 2027 · Current World Archaeology
item.description: Current World Archaeology's free annual competition wants photographs on an archaeological or heritage theme, from any location and taken at any time. The winning image and three runners-up are published in the magazine and shown at the CA Live! conference in London; the winner also gets two conference tickets and a trophy. — Deadline: January 25, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Prize: Magazine publication + Conference tickets + Trophy.

item.title: Call for New Work — Research Meetings 2027 · Source Photographic Review
item.description: Source's editors are booking Zoom meetings with photographers from, or living in, the UK and Ireland to look at new, unpublished work for the magazine's Portfolio section. Shortlisted applicants get a 30-minute slot across three days in March 2027; entry is free and submission is by email. — Deadline: February 25, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Prize: Editor meeting + Possible publication.

item.title: Women & Biosphere: Stories to Tell · MabPhoto
item.description: A free international competition from the three UNESCO Biosphere Reserves of Emilia-Romagna on women in nature, society and work. Its three categories are water, culture and profession, each split between images made in Emilia-Romagna and anywhere else; 36 works are awarded from a pool of over €5,000 in photographic gear and other items, and the winning images travel as an exhibition. — Deadline: January 20, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Prize: Equipment prizes + Touring exhibition.

item.title: Linz Open Foto Exhibition 2027 – Portrait · Fotografische Gesellschaft Oberösterreich
item.description: A portrait-only open call from the Fotografische Gesellschaft Oberösterreich: 150 finalist images hang for 30 days at the OÖ-Fotogalerie in Linz's Kulturquartier, go online and appear in an accompanying booklet. Files must be 2:3 and print-ready at 60x40 cm. Open worldwide from age 16; no AI-generated images. — Deadline: January 7, 2027. Entry fee: €12 for 1 image, €19 for 2, €25 for 3. Prize: Exhibition + Booklet.

item.title: Call for Gallery Proposals (2028) · Silverwood Park
item.description: Silverwood Park, a Three Rivers Park District facility on 120 acres north of Minneapolis, is programming the 2028 season of its 1,300-square-foot gallery and Annex Gallery. Proposals may be existing work, new projects or site-specific installations; the park shows nature-inspired art, photography included. Free to enter, open to Midwest artists 18 and over; selected artists get a small stipend and cover transport and installation themselves. — Deadline: January 31, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition + Stipend.

item.title: Here to There · White Bear Center for the Arts
item.description: White Bear Center for the Arts is curating a show about journeys — experiences, landscapes, people, memories and moments — for its Exhibition Hall, 6 February to 26 March 2027. Recent 2D work is eligible, photography named among the media, and up to three pieces may be entered. Selected work is hand-delivered in late January and the centre takes 40% commission on sales. — Deadline: December 14, 2026. Entry fee: $30 for up to 3 works. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: ACCORD Art Exhibition 2027 · The Art Department, Paisley
item.description: The sixth ACCORD Annual Art Exhibition runs two months at The Art Department's Paisley gallery, 16 March to 15 May 2027, in aid of ACCORD Hospice. Photography is named among the media, entry is free and up to six works may be submitted, with selection in early February. Only work offered for sale is accepted, and selected pieces carry a £5 hanging fee. — Deadline: January 31, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Additional fees: £5 hanging fee per work if selected. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Artrageous Light · Whitewater Arts Alliance
item.description: The fourth Artrageous juried exhibition at Whitewater Arts Alliance's Cultural Arts Center gallery in Wisconsin takes work on the theme of light, with photography judged as its own category. Monetary awards total up to $1,250, led by a $500 Best of Show, and accepted work also goes into an online exhibit. Accepted pieces must reach the gallery physically, shipped at the artist's expense. — Deadline: January 17, 2027. Entry fee: $40 for up to 2 works, $20 each additional ($36 members, 50% off students). Prize: $500 Best + Exhibition.

item.title: 2027 Thin Line Photo
item.description: Thin Line's storytelling festival in Denton, Texas invites photographers worldwide to submit to five themed categories. Selected photographs are printed on archival paper, mounted frameless and shown in Denton galleries during the March 2027 festival and for weeks after, and photographers keep the prints. Every accepted photographer gets an Artist Pass, plus hotel nights if travelling from outside Dallas–Fort Worth. — Deadline: January 15, 2027. Entry fee: $8.50 per image ($4.25 each after 5 in one order). Prize: $500 award + Exhibition.

item.title: Arts to Hearts Magazine Issue 16 — The Art of Starting Again
item.description: The 16th edition of Arts to Hearts Magazine marks its fourth anniversary on the theme The Art of Starting Again, publishing 100 artists across painting, photography, sculpture and other disciplines. Every selected artist receives a two-page feature with a professionally prepared interview, and one receives a $500 cash award. Open to emerging and established artists worldwide; AI-generated work is not eligible. — Deadline: December 27, 2026. Entry fee: $21–$100 (tiered, 1–20 images). Prize: $500 + Publication.

item.title: Northern California Dreamin' · Sanchez Art Center
item.description: Bay Area and Santa Cruz artists 18 and over submit up to three works on the hopes and promises that have drawn people to the region, from past decades to a vision of the future. Sanchez Art Center's East Gallery runs the show 19 February to 21 March 2027 and can take 2D or 3D work as well as some short video. A short artist statement for each work is part of the jurying. — Deadline: January 12, 2027. Entry fee: $15 per work. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Gilded: A Juried National Exhibit of Artworks with Gilded Elements · d'Art Center
item.description: d'Art Center's Main Gallery in Norfolk wants work in any medium whose gilded elements — a thin layer of gold, silver, palladium, aluminium or copper — are integral to the piece, shown 13 February to 13 March 2027. Open to artists 18 and over living in the United States, with work made in the last eight years, under 50 pounds and 60 inches. Awards are $500, $300 and $150. — Deadline: January 10, 2027. Entry fee: $35 for 3 works, $5 each additional. Prize: $500 award + Exhibition.

item.title: Heritage: Call for Student Work · Umpqua Valley Arts
item.description: Oregon high school students aged 14 to 18 submit up to three works on what heritage means to them, for a juried show in Umpqua Valley Arts' Student Gallery in Roseburg, 11 June to 21 August 2027. All media including photography are eligible, video excepted; first, second and third place awards are $300, $200 and $100. — Deadline: April 23, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition + $300 prize.

item.title: Becoming · LELA International Artists
item.description: A juried group show on change and transformation at The Los Angeles Makery, 4–28 March 2027, open to LELA members and non-members aged 18 and over. Painting, sculpture, photography, mixed media and digital art are accepted; video, AI-generated work and digital reproductions are not. Accepted work is hand-delivered in Los Angeles on 3 March, the gallery keeps 30% of sales, and no awards are offered. — Deadline: February 13, 2027. Entry fee: $45 for up to 2 works ($38 members). Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Uncommon Ground · CoVault Artist Network
item.description: A Portland nonprofit arts network takes over Curb Gallery in NW Portland for three months with two linked juried shows: PLACE in January and February, BELONGING in March. Photography is named among the welcomed media, but the same eligibility line reads "no prints or AI-generated works" and the Accepted Media list gives only 2D and 3D work, so confirm before paying. Hand delivery only, and wall space favours smaller pieces. — Deadline: December 5, 2026. Entry fee: $35 for 3 artworks, $5 each additional. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: FUTURES Talents 2027 · Bienal Fotografia do Porto
item.description: Bienal Fotografia do Porto nominates five emerging photographic artists living in Portugal to the European FUTURES platform for 2027. Each receives a €500 artist fee, up to three mentorship sessions, Magnum-led workshops and a place at the FUTURES Annual Event in Vienna, with a €600 contribution towards travel, accommodation and meals. Free to enter; shortlisted applicants must be available for a January interview. — Deadline: December 30, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Prize: €500 + Mentorship + €600 travel.

item.title: Barcelona Showcase · HUGE Gallery
item.description: A three-day group show at Carrer de la Flor del Lliri 4, Ciutat Vella, 24–26 September 2027, in the venue or on screen. Emerging and independent artists can apply without previous exhibitions, from anywhere, without attending. Applying is free but selected artists pay for their place, and the Apply link is a mailing-list signup that emails the form. — Deadline: September 11, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Additional fees: £45+ digital or £140+ physical show fee if selected. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Prague Showcase · HUGE Gallery
item.description: A three-day group show at Malířská 231/6, Prague 7, 21–23 May 2027, in the venue or on screen. Emerging and independent artists can apply without previous exhibitions, from anywhere, without attending. Applying is free but selected artists pay for their place, and the Apply link is a mailing-list signup that emails the form. — Deadline: May 8, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Additional fees: £45+ digital or £140+ physical show fee if selected. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: The Shape of Our Surroundings · St. Louis Artists' Guild
item.description: A juried show at a St. Louis guild running since 1886, on the environments that shape us — everyday objects and scenes, built landscapes, environmental change, geographic boundaries. All media, so lens-based work competes alongside painting and sculpture; the juror is not yet named. US residents 18 and over, up to three works; the Guild takes 35% commission on sales. — Deadline: December 28, 2026. Entry fee: $35 for up to 3 works ($24 members). Prize: Exhibition + $1,000 cash.

item.title: IPFA Award 2026 · International Photography Festivals Association
item.description: One €20 application puts a ten-photograph project in front of curators from 20 international photography festivals. Twenty photographers each win a solo exhibition at the festival that chose them, with €300 toward production; fifty finalists join a touring group show opening July 2027 in Barcelona. Any nationality, any level, open theme. — Deadline: January 11, 2027. Entry fee: €20 for 10 images. Prize: Solo exhibition + Touring show.

item.title: Christmas & Celebration — Special Edition · Collect Art
item.description: Collect Art, the Tbilisi-based independent art magazine, asks artists worldwide to work with the spirit of the festive season — its colours, symbols, rituals and gatherings. Photography is named among the eligible media and entry is free; selected artists pay €25 for a 2–6 page print and digital spread with interview. — Deadline: December 23, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Additional fees: €25 fee if selected. Prize: Publication.

item.title: Silence & Noise · Collect Art
item.description: Collect Art's curated online exhibition and special magazine edition takes on the dialogue between stillness and sound — quiet reflection against overwhelming noise, harmony against chaos. Open to artists worldwide aged 18 and over with photography among the named media; entry is free and selected artists pay €55. — Deadline: December 29, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Additional fees: €55 fee if selected. Prize: Publication + Online exhibition.

item.title: Faces · Collect Art
item.description: Collect Art wants faces: portraits rendered with obsessive tenderness, faces veiled, cropped, doubled or erased, a stranger glimpsed on a train, a self-portrait that refuses to look like you. Photography is named among the eligible media; entry is free and selected artists pay €55 for an online show and a magazine spread. — Deadline: December 29, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Additional fees: €55 fee if selected. Prize: Publication + Online exhibition.

item.title: Loneliness · Collect Art
item.description: Collect Art's loneliness edition looks for the space between solitude and the wish for connection — empty rooms, distant relationships, the unseen emotions we carry. Open to artists worldwide aged 18 and over, photography included; applying is free and selected artists pay €55 for an online exhibition and a magazine spread. — Deadline: December 23, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Additional fees: €55 fee if selected. Prize: Publication + Online exhibition.

item.title: Remembrance — Special Edition · Collect Art
item.description: Remembrance, for Collect Art, is the act of keeping something alive — "the faded photograph kept in a drawer," a song, the smell of a house you no longer live in. Open to visual artists worldwide aged 18 and over with photography named; entry is free and selected artists pay €25. — Deadline: December 28, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Additional fees: €25 fee if selected. Prize: Publication.

item.title: Life / Death · Collect Art
item.description: Collect Art's LIFE/DEATH edition wants the threshold where beginning and ending touch: "where a bloom opens from rot, where a body remembers and forgets, where grief becomes tenderness." Photography is among the named media; entry is free and selected artists pay €55 for an online show and a magazine spread. — Deadline: December 28, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Additional fees: €55 fee if selected. Prize: Publication + Online exhibition.

item.title: The Artist Signature — Special Edition · Collect Art
item.description: No theme this time: Collect Art asks for a selection of works that together form the most accurate portrait of who you are as an artist — a practice with a signature even when the subject changes. Photography is named among the media; entry is free and selected artists pay €25. — Deadline: December 29, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Additional fees: €25 fee if selected. Prize: Publication.

item.title: Wildlife Photographer of the Year · Natural History Museum
item.description: The Natural History Museum's annual wildlife photography competition, closing 3 December, runs 19 categories and shows winners in London before touring worldwide. The Grand Title takes £15,000, category winners £1,250, and every awarded photograph is published in the WPY Portfolio book. Open to photographers 18 and over; the £35 fee is waived for entrants aged 18 to 26. — Deadline: December 3, 2026. Entry fee: £35 (free for ages 18 to 26). Prize: £15,000 + Exhibition + Publication.

item.title: Water & Wood · Not Shockboxx
item.description: Not Shockboxx, a contemporary gallery in Hermosa Beach, invites artists to submit work for Water & Wood, a free group show running 16-23 January 2027. Up to five pieces may be entered and not all are guaranteed entrance; owner Jessica Accamando and gallery manager Carin O'Hara curate this first edition. The gallery shows both on its own walls and online on Artsy; this call page does not say which. — Deadline: December 16, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Winter Open Juried Exhibition · West Portal Gallery
item.description: West Portal Gallery's winter open, hung salon-style in its San Francisco space with an opening reception on 12 February. All media are welcome and photography is named; volunteer jurors from the Azgour Art Group select, and three cash awards total $500. Open to artists in the Bay Area, Central Valley and Central Coast counties; drop-off and pickup are in person only. — Deadline: January 8, 2027. Entry fee: $40 for up to 3 works, $10 each additional. Prize: $500 awards + Exhibition.

item.title: Echoes of the After Image · Floyd Center for the Arts
item.description: A national juried exhibition at the Floyd Center for the Arts on memory and its distortions, hung in the Hayloft Gallery from February to April 2027. Photography sits in the named media list alongside painting, printmaking and sculpture, with three cash awards totalling $525 chosen by juror Nathan Popp. Open to US artists 18 and over; the centre keeps 40% on sales. — Deadline: December 23, 2026. Entry fee: $25. Prize: Exhibition + $525 awards.

item.title: CALYX Journal Art Submissions
item.description: CALYX Press, the oldest feminist press in the United States, takes free year-round art submissions for its biannual journal, whose every issue carries a glossy full-colour art insert. Open to women and nonbinary artists; the call names no medium, and the journal has published photography in a Winter 1982 special photography issue and the Winter 2012 edition. The Art Collective considers submissions only in May and December, so response times vary. — Deadline: Continuous. Entry fee: Free. Prize: Print publication.

item.title: La Napoule Art Foundation — International Artist Residency Fall 2027
item.description: Two one-month residencies at the Château de La Napoule on the Côte d'Azur, running October 12 to November 10 and November 15 to December 12, 2027; applicants pick one. Residents get a single room, a studio, a stipend, and breakfast and dinner on weekdays. Open to artists 18 and over of any discipline or nationality, but the historic château is not wheelchair accessible. — Deadline: March 5, 2027. Entry fee: $30. Prize: Residency + Stipend.

item.title: FORMAT27 Portfolio Review Bursaries
item.description: FORMAT offers three bursary places at its International Portfolio Review, held in Derby on 12-13 March 2027 alongside the FORMAT27 biennale launch weekend. Each recipient receives two free reviews with industry professionals. Open to photographers and artists in any discipline, but you must travel to Derby to attend in person. — Deadline: December 6, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Prize: None listed.

item.title: Kraszna-Krausz Book Awards 2027
item.description: The Kraszna-Krausz Foundation's annual awards honour books on photography and on the moving image, with £5,000 to the author of each winning title. Free to enter, open to publishers, authors and self-publishers; books must be first published in 2026, available to buy in the UK, and carry significant text. Once eligibility is confirmed, three non-returnable hard copies must be sent, one for each judge. — Deadline: January 31, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Prize: £5,000.

item.title: Tendrils Issue 3 — Trauma and the Government
item.description: Tendrils is a trauma-informed print journal, and its third issue asks how policy, laws and programmes have rippled through communities and lives; the work may be historical or contemporary and may concern governments anywhere in the world. Any medium, two works maximum, free to enter, open to US-based artists 18 and over; each selected contributor is paid a $20 honorarium and receives a printed copy. — Deadline: December 19, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Prize: $20 honorarium + Publication.

item.title: Color Unleashed · Arts Center East
item.description: A juried all-media show at Arts Center East in Vernon, Connecticut, on color as the subject itself — bold hues, unexpected combinations, vibrant patterns, subtle shades. Photography is a named accepted medium; artists 18 and over may submit up to five pieces, with awards at the January 30 reception. Work must arrive wired and ready to hang, and anything not collected within 30 days of the close becomes the gallery's property. — Deadline: January 5, 2027. Entry fee: $35 for 1 piece, $5 each additional ($30 members, up to 5 pieces). Prize: Exhibition + Awards.

item.title: Absence of Color · Arts Center East
item.description: A juried monochrome show at Arts Center East in Vernon, Connecticut, for work built from black, white and every shade between — contrast, texture, mood and form without color. Juror Greg Shea; photography is a named accepted medium and artists 18 and over may enter up to five pieces, wired and ready to hang. Unclaimed work becomes the gallery's property 30 days after the close. — Deadline: January 5, 2027. Entry fee: $35 for 1 piece, $5 each additional ($30 members, up to 5 pieces). Prize: Exhibition + Awards.

item.title: Finality & Infinity: Explorations of Time · Emery Community Arts Center
item.description: A thematic show at the University of Maine at Farmington on time as both measurable and immeasurable — history, chronometry, memory, seasonal cycles, decay, imagined futures, or time used as a medium. Open to all mediums and ages 18 up, five works maximum, no entry fee; the show runs 29 January to 11 March 2027. — Deadline: December 13, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Awarded Residencies 2027 & 2028 · Cove Park
item.description: Cove Park funds two-week to three-month residencies in rural Argyll between May 2027 and December 2028, paying £775 a week in 2027 plus travel and, where needed, materials, access and visa costs. For 2027-28 applicants must be based in the UK, Central or South America, or from that diaspora in Europe or North America. Any art form and any career stage, but anyone in formal education at the deadline is not eligible. — Deadline: December 11, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Prize: Funded residency + £775/week + Travel.

item.title: Artist in Residence Program 2027 · Bernheim Forest and Arboretum
item.description: Up to four artists live on site at Bernheim for six to eight weeks in 2027 with a $2,500 stipend and a furnished cabin; one place is reserved for a Kentucky-area artist and one for work on the climate crisis. Professional visual artists in any medium may apply; undergraduates may not. — Deadline: November 30, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Prize: Residency + $2,500 stipend.

item.title: Swiss Art Awards 2027 · Federal Office of Culture
item.description: The Swiss federal art competition, held annually since 1899, is open to artists, architects, critics, editors and curators who are Swiss citizens or resident in Switzerland; the Art section sets no restriction on medium. Applicants submit a PDF dossier, and those selected present an original work in the Swiss Art Awards exhibition at Messe Basel. Students on an art or architecture course cannot enter unless they already hold a master's degree. — Deadline: December 3, 2026. Entry fee: Free. Prize: CHF 25,000 + Exhibition.

item.title: We Represent · Studio Montclair
item.description: Studio Montclair's winter show at its Leach Gallery looks for work on heritage, identity, resilience and community, the pull between historical memory and lived experience, in any medium including video and installation. Up to three works, free for members and $42 otherwise, with cash awards; the non-profit keeps 30% of sales and local artists owe a two-hour gallery sit or a $40 fee. — Deadline: December 23, 2026. Entry fee: $42 (free for members). Prize: Cash awards + Exhibition.

item.title: Windows on the World · Schelfhaudt Gallery, University of Bridgeport
item.description: The Schelfhaudt Gallery at the University of Bridgeport wants photographs of people outside the United States in their everyday environment, not travel highlights but the struggles, joys and celebrations of ordinary life. Up to 20 images may be entered for the January to March 2027 show; framed work is preferred, artists pay shipping both ways, and the gallery takes 50% of any sale. — Deadline: December 31, 2026. Entry fee: $10 for 1 image, $10 each additional image. Prize: Exhibition.

item.title: Turn the Soil · ARTS Southeast
item.description: ARTS Southeast's spring Supporter Exhibition in Savannah asks for new work tied to the natural world, including work made with natural materials. Current Supporters, from $25 students or $50 artists, may submit up to four wall-hanging works, capped at 30 inches in every direction, for a juried show running 21 January to 15 May 2027. ARTS Southeast takes no commission, so artists keep 100% of sales. — Deadline: January 9, 2027. Entry fee: Free. Additional fees: $50 ARTS Southeast Supporter membership ($25 students). Prize: Exhibition.
